statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness
The patient has known atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The diagnosis codes are I48.91, I25.10, and I49.5
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
